name: Osakasayama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Osakasayama city emblem in red: a winged device with a pointed top above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Osakasayama, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1987.

features.role: Osakasayama city emblem — a winged device with a pointed top above a ring
